subject: Next steps: PO routing, DPA confirmation, and subprocessor clarification
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana@quantiflow.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantiflow.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding items and PO routing

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — Quantiflow is excited to get Redwood live for inference in our platform. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of items before we issue the PO so we don’t hit delays on our side: 

1) Can you confirm whether the DPA we executed covers processing in US regions only or also EU (we need the scope for our compliance team)?
2) Could you send a current SOC 2 report (or a link) and indicate the report date + scope (control environment for hosting vs product)?
3) We received a subprocessor CSV from your team last quarter; do you have an updated list? We need vendor-level contacts for any subprocessor with access to customer data.
4) PO routing: does Redwood accept emailed PO PDFs to billing@redwood.com, or do we need to upload via the vendor portal? And does Redwood support net-30 payment?

We plan to submit PO QF-8342 once these items are clarified. Attaching our procurement intake template for your reference.

Appreciate a short reply with the links / attachments and any gotchas on the PO.

Best,
Sana Patel
Head of Procurement
Quantiflow, Inc.

Attachment: QF-PO-intake-template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@quantiflow.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding items and PO routing

Sana — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Vanessa (billing/ops) and Ben (security/compliance) to confirm specifics. Quick answers below, and Ben will drop the SOC 2 link + subprocessor CSV. Vanessa, could you confirm PO routing and payment terms?

Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

---
Short answers: 
- DPA scope: our standard DPA has a processing addendum that covers global processing but includes region-specific data residency options. The executed copy shows the standard global scope; if you need an EU-specific amendment we can supply one for EEA-restricted data.
- PO routing: Vanessa?
- Payment terms: we offer net-30 standard; net-45 or custom terms require finance approval for deals above $100k.
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@quantiflow.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jun 2028 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding items and PO routing

Hi Sana — attaching the items you asked for.

Attachment: Quantiflow-SOC2-report-2028-03.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Quantiflow-subprocessors-2028.csv (csv)
Attachment: Signed-DPA-Redwood.pdf (pdf)

Notes on scope and subprocessor details:
- SOC 2 Type II: period 2027-09-01 through 2028-03-31. Scope covers Redwood hosted API and our dedicated deployment control plane; it excludes customer-managed on-prem components (called out in section 2.3).
- Subprocessors CSV: includes vendor name, primary contact, purpose, and whether they have access to plaintext customer inputs or only aggregated telemetry. We flag any with potential plaintext access in the last column.
- Signed DPA: this is the standard SOW-level DPA we execute. If Quantiflow requires EU-only processing constraints, let us know and we can provide an amendment with data residency and transfer mechanisms (SCCs).

If you want, we can do a 20-minute call with our security ops lead to walk through the SOC 2 controls and subprocessor access levels.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@quantiflow.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jun 2028 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding items and PO routing

Hi Sana — forwarding our PO instructions and confirming next steps so the PO doesn’t bounce: 

1) Routing: We prefer POs via our vendor portal (vendors.redwood.com/portal) because that triggers automated invoice routing and ensures faster processing. If you must email, send the signed PO PDF to billing@redwood.com AND cc ops@redwood.com so finance picks it up.
2) PO format: include the following on the PO so our system maps fields correctly — vendor name, Quantiflow EIN (we can share a template), PO number (QF-8342), billing contact, billing address, line item description (Redwood Inference API access), term (net-30), and any special tax or remittance instructions.
3) Net terms: net-30 is available by default. For net-45 we need an approval ticket; please indicate if that will be a hard requirement on your PO.
4) Accounting lead: once you upload the PO to the portal or email it to billing@redwood.com and cc ops@redwood.com, we'll create invoice QF-8342 in our system and confirm expected invoice date.

I'll also flag this for a 1st-tier expedited routing if you need it to align with your quarter close.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if anything is unclear.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Attachment: PO-upload-instructions.pdf (pdf)
